description: This file defines an interface named RouteInterface within the Slim Framework, outlining methods for route configuration and execution, including management of route patterns, callables, middleware, and request handling.

methods.name: getInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Returns the invocation strategy associated with the route.

methods.name: setInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Sets the invocation strategy for the route.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves the list of HTTP methods for the route.

methods.name: getPattern
methods.description: Returns the route pattern as a string.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Retrieves the route's callable, which can be a function, class method, or string.

methods.name: setCallable
methods.description: Sets the callable for the route.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the optional name of the route.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the route.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for the route.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Retrieves a specific argument for the route.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns all arguments associated with the route.

methods.name: setArguments
methods.description: Replaces route arguments with a new set (deprecated).

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the route's middleware stack.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds middleware implementing MiddlewareInterface to the route.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the route with provided arguments for use.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the route, traversing middleware and returning the response.
